dedupe_keys.name: realestatecore domain ontology for buildings and real estate

description: RealEstateCore is a domain ontology for buildings from the RealEstateCore Consortium, described as a common language for control of buildings and development of new services, preparing buildings to interact with the smart city. It does not aim to be a new standard but to bridge existing ones, mapping them pragmatically through annotations. Its structure separates spaces, assets, building systems and other types, with parthood expressed by hasPart and isPartOf so that instances only contain parts of the same type; browsable reference documentation and modelling guides are published on the developer site. Coverage: commercial and residential property, not tied to a place. Access: ontology files in the GitHub repository and documentation online. Licence: BSD 3-Clause (2022); free. Caveats: the project website did not respond on the day, so facts come from the repository README and licence. Simulation uses are a property-owner view of spaces, assets and systems for digital twins and portfolio analytics that sit above control-level ontologies. Related records: Brick Schema and Project Haystack.
